status: FROZEN after Phase 9C. Gate FAILED (4 of 5 criteria). Retained as the recorded configuration; no further converter tuning.

registered.selection: max exact macro-IoU inside interval; tolerant occupied IoU tie-breaker only

decision: Use first-frame scale anchoring with the ORIGINAL exact-depth converter for Phase 9D onward. The robust converter is not significantly better than first-frame alone on validation (occupied IoU -0.012 [-0.030,+0.006] n.s.) and loses 68% of macro-IoU on perfect input (0.290 vs 0.908 ceiling), because the fitted sigma(d) of 1.32-2.00 m is comparable to room dimensions.
claim: BOUNDED CLAIM. The tested residual-envelope robust integration method -- conservative carving to d_hat - k_f*sigma with a soft occupied band over +/- k_o*sigma -- did not improve imperfect-depth mapping and severely degraded clean-depth performance at the observed error magnitude. This does NOT establish that every uncertainty-aware mapping method must fail; it establishes that this particular formulation is unsuitable when sigma(d) is comparable to scene dimensions.

sigma_provenance.note: Two sigma figures appear in the record and are NOT in conflict; they come from different inputs.

component_test_synthetic.source: SYNTHETIC fixture in the component verification: pred = gt + N(0, 0.05*gt), i.e. 5% relative noise imposed by construction to check that fit_error_envelope is monotone and range-dependent.
component_test_synthetic.purpose: unit test of the fitting function, not a measurement

phase9c_real.source: Depth Anything V2 Metric Indoor residuals against habitat sensor depth on the real calibration subset.

sigma_provenance.scaling_order: First-frame scale is applied BEFORE fitting: the envelope is fitted on |c*d_hat - d_gt|, so it describes residual error AFTER calibration -- which is what the integrator must tolerate. See ablate_converter.py, 'sigma(d_hat) from CALIBRATION residuals only, after first-frame scaling'.
sigma_provenance.consistency_check: sigma/d ~ 1.53/2.0 = 0.77 at 2 m, i.e. ~77% relative error at the 90th percentile. Independently, 9A measured mean AbsRel 0.711 on the raw estimator. A 0.9-quantile envelope must exceed a mean relative error, so the two measurements agree. The synthetic fixture was 15x more optimistic than reality.
